# Open Keychain 3D

> Open Keychain 3D is a free browser-based customizer for five printable templates: name keychain,
> articulated name, nameplate, plant label, and personalized magnet. The magnet uses a blind rear
> pocket for a standard disc magnet, which is glued in after printing.

One-off designs and individual exports are free without an account. Geometry and exports run locally
in the browser. Export options are STL, one-model color-separated 3MF, and merged 3MF. The paid Maker
plan adds reusable presets and batch tools; individual exports remain free. Names are not sent to the
server. Optional Google Fonts needs an API key and internet access; built-in fonts work offline. The
Google Fonts catalog request and selected font file do not include the entered text.

The software is MIT-licensed; commercial use, modification, and distribution are allowed when the
copyright and license notice are retained. Bundled fonts carry separate SIL Open Font License 1.1
terms and may not be sold by themselves. WebMCP is a progressive, native-only enhancement in
supported browsers; the optional API server is not required for the customizer workflow.

## Product

- [Open Keychain 3D](https://open-keychain.com/) — product home and localized content.
- [Customizer](https://open-keychain.com/create) — create and export a printable design.
- [Privacy](https://open-keychain.com/privacy) — privacy and analytics information.

## Templates

- [Template catalog](https://open-keychain.com/templates/) — browse printable design templates.
- [Name keychain](https://open-keychain.com/templates/name-keychain/) — a standard name keychain.
- [Articulated name](https://open-keychain.com/templates/articulated-name/) — linked articulated letters.
- [Nameplate](https://open-keychain.com/templates/nameplate/) — a rounded embedded nameplate.
- [Plant label](https://open-keychain.com/templates/plant-label/) — a printable garden label.
- [Personalized magnet](https://open-keychain.com/create?template=magnet&lang=en) — a custom rear-pocket magnet.

## Guides

- [Guide catalog](https://open-keychain.com/guides/) — printing and format guidance.
- [STL vs 3MF](https://open-keychain.com/guides/stl-vs-3mf/) — choose an export format.
- [How to print a name keychain](https://open-keychain.com/guides/how-to-print-a-name-keychain/) — prepare a print.
- [Articulated vs standard keychain](https://open-keychain.com/guides/articulated-vs-standard-keychain/) — compare templates.
- [Printable plant label guide](https://open-keychain.com/guides/printable-plant-label-guide/) — make a plant label.

- [Source code](https://github.com/capynq/open-keychain) — the open-source repository.
